name: Hostinger

typography.pairing_note: Single-family system: DM Sans across the board — bold, tight-tracking weights for display headings and regular weight for body. Geometric-humanist sans that reads modern and approachable, exactly Hostinger's brand voice.

layout: White base with a signature Hostinger purple (#673de6) as the primary action color, offset by deep meteorite-violet (#0a0a2c / #2f1c6a) dark sections; generous spacing, big confident headlines, rounded cards and pill buttons; conversion-first with discount badges and social proof.
components: pricing tier cards (Single/Premium/Cloud) with recommended highlight
notes: Global web-hosting brand: vibrant Hostinger purple (#673de6) on white with deep-violet meteorite dark sections and DM Sans throughout. Conversion-optimized SaaS/hosting layout — pricing tiers, discount badges, uptime stats. This is the only web-hosting vertical in the library; contrast with fwr-agencia (neon-green dark techy agency) and sweetags (neon design agency).
